_schema.platform: Trait Transfer & Genome Editing Intelligence Platform
_schema.principle: Gene identity and literature references are machine-verified against NCBI Gene and PubMed. Portability, linkage drag, pleiotropy and IP remain indicative research signals curated by a breeder, not database facts.

verification_states.verified: Gene ID and at least one reference confirmed in a public database.
verification_states.partial: Gene confirmed, reference not resolved (or the reverse).
verification_states.unverified: Not yet checked, or database returned no match.
verification_states.conflicted: Database answer disagrees with the curated claim — needs human review.

Level 1.label: Commercially Validated
Level 1.desc: Verified in commercial cultivars or released products.

Level 3.label: Genetic Association
Level 3.desc: Supported by QTL, GWAS, linkage mapping, or natural allelic variation.

Level 4.label: Candidate Gene
Level 4.desc: Inferred via orthology, expression profiling, or pathway homology.

Level 5.label: Hypothesis / Research Gap
Level 5.desc: Exploratory polygenic or multi-stress target requiring functional validation.

portability_tiers.t1: Native Edit (NGT Cat-1 candidate — crop's own gene/promoter)
portability_tiers.t2: Cisgenic / Introgression (Crossable wild relative — check linkage drag)
portability_tiers.t3: Transgenic / De Novo (Outside primary gene pool)

curated_references.supports: CRISPR/Cas9 knockout of SlTOM1a and SlTOM3 (sltom1a/sltom3) makes tomato asymptomatic to ToBRFV, with 516-fold lower viral RNA and 25-fold lower coat protein than wild type at 12 days post-inoculation. The abstract uses SlTOM1a, SlTOM1b and SlTOM3, so the draft's SlTOM1a is the paper's own symbol — the title's 'SlTOM1' is the generic form.
curated_references.does_not_support: The claimed locus Solyc01g105140 is not shown to map to either symbol. The same paper reports that sltom1a/sltom3 plants remain susceptible to another tobamovirus, so the resistance is virus-specific and must not be presented as broad tobamovirus resistance.

curated_references.supports: Prickle formation in eggplant is governed by a single dominant gene at the PE (Prickly Eggplant) locus on chromosome 6, fine-mapped to a 9233 bp interval holding one candidate: SmLOG1, a LONELY GUY (LOG)-family cytokinin biosynthetic enzyme expressed mainly in immature prickles. CRISPR-Cas9 knockout of SmLOG1 abolished prickles in all tissues. So SmLOG1 is the paper's own symbol and PE is the locus name, not a competing symbol.
curated_references.does_not_support: The draft's SmMYB candidates are a different gene and are not supported by this paper. Note also that the causal sequence variation reported here lies only in the non-coding region, with a CAPS marker from a SNP at -735 bp in the SmLOG1 promoter — so the route is promoter editing or marker-assisted selection, not a coding knockout of the natural allele.
